findings.description: Default admin credentials hardcoded in seed file
findings.evidence:
const email = String(process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL || process.env.ADMIN_USERNAME || 'admin@capitalnetwork.local').trim()
const password = String(process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'change-me-strong-password').trim()
findings.recommendation: Remove default credentials, require ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD in environment, fail seed if not provided

findings.description: Default salt hardcoded for password hashing
findings.recommendation: Remove default salt, require ADMIN_PASSWORD_SALT in environment, fail if not provided

findings.description: Use of dangerouslySetInnerHTML with large HTML content
findings.recommendation: Replace dangerouslySetInnerHTML with safe React components or sanitize HTML with DOMPurify

findings.description: JWT tokens missing required claims (iss, aud, iat, nbf)
findings.evidence: jwt.sign({ role: 'admin', name: admin.name, email: admin.email }, accessSecret, { subject: admin.id, expiresIn: ACCESS_TTL })
findings.recommendation: Add iss, aud, iat, nbf claims to all JWT tokens

findings.description: JWT refresh token TTL is 30 days, exceeds recommended 7 days
findings.recommendation: Reduce refresh token TTL to 7 days

findings.description: No MIME type validation, no magic byte validation for file uploads
findings.evidence: Only extension-based validation in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS set
findings.recommendation: Add MIME type validation and magic byte verification
Use crypto.randomUUID() for complete filename randomization

findings.description: Wildcard CORS origin allows all domains
findings.recommendation: Replace wildcard with specific origin allowlist

findings.description: CORS allows all origins in development mode
findings.recommendation: Even in development, use specific allowlist or require explicit CORS_ORIGINS

findings.evidence: helmet() does not include Referrer-Policy by default
helmet() does not include Permissions-Policy by default
findings.recommendation: Add Permissions-Policy to restrict browser features

findings.description: Global rate limit of 120 req/min may be too permissive
findings.recommendation: Reduce to 60 req/min or implement endpoint-specific limits

findings.description: No CSRF protection detected for state-changing requests
findings.evidence: No CSRF middleware or token validation found
findings.recommendation: Implement CSRF protection for all state-changing endpoints

findings.description: Version endpoint exposes Node.js version and environment
findings.evidence: res.status(200).json({ name: pkg.name, version: pkg.version, node: process.version, env: process.env.NODE_ENV })
findings.recommendation: Remove sensitive information from version endpoint in production

findings.description: Uploads directory served publicly via express.static
findings.recommendation: Move uploads outside web root or add authentication middleware

findings.description: ADMIN_TOKEN legacy support still exists, rejected in production
